annotations.title: SPF, DKIM & DMARC Record Linter & Generator API

description: SPF, DKIM & DMARC Record Linter & Generator API: Lint existing SPF/DMARC strings and generate clean, RFC-formatted DNS TXT records. (Endpoint: POST /v1/email-dns-generator)

allow_a.description: When true, includes the domain's `a` mechanism (+1 DNS lookup) in the generated SPF record.

allow_mx.description: When true, includes the domain's `mx` mechanism (+1 DNS lookup) in the generated SPF record.

custom_includes.description: Additional custom SPF `include:` domains (max 20; each adds ~2 estimated DNS lookups).

dmarc_pct.description: Percentage of failing messages (`pct=`, 1–100) subject to the DMARC policy (default 100).

dmarc_subdomain_policy.description: Optional DMARC subdomain policy (`sp=`); inherits `dmarc_policy` when omitted.

existing_dmarc.description: Optional existing DMARC TXT record to lint for RFC 7489 errors.

existing_spf.description: Optional existing SPF TXT record to lint for RFC 7208 errors.

ip4.description: Authorized IPv4 addresses or CIDR blocks (`ip4:...`, max 50) for the SPF record.

ip6.description: Authorized IPv6 addresses or CIDR blocks (`ip6:...`, max 50) for the SPF record.

providers.description: Known ESPs whose official SPF includes should be added.

rua_emails.description: Aggregate DMARC/TLS-RPT report recipient emails (`rua=mailto:...`, max 10; defaults to `dmarc-reports@<domain>`).

ruf_emails.description: Optional forensic DMARC failure report recipient emails (`ruf=mailto:...`, max 10).

name: tinplate_email_dns_generator
